name: GrandGalemon
main_effect:
＜Vortex＞ (At the end of your turn, this Digimon may attack an opponent's Digimon. With this effect, it can attack the turn it was played.)
[When Digivolving] You may Suspend 1 Digimon. If this effect suspends your Digimon, this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's Digimon's effects until the end of their turn.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon attacks your opponent's Digimon, you may unsuspend this Digimon.
